name: Layout Swapper
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Save, switch, and auto-restore Hyprland window layouts. An autosave daemon keeps your live session current, so after a power loss or reboot every app comes back on its workspace. Freeze named snapshots and swap between them from the bar, the menu, or SUPER + ALT + L: the windows a snapshot does not mention are parked (not closed) and returned when you switch back.

barWidget.description: Shows the active layout; click to switch, right-click to save a new one, middle-click to set what happens at login.
